_doc: Single source list for the avg-delta / POS_SYM evidence tooling (tools/v15_avg2_*.py, tools/avg2_sources.py). EVID 2026-10-01. Contaminated crypto results (look-ahead in 1h/4h/D arrays, fixed by AUDIT/001 engine ecacb3be) STAY in POS_SYM / n_sym; AVG_DELTA prefers clean results. NEVER drop evidence by moving a folder: use tools/v15_quarantine_keep_evidence.sh (it uses the contaminated_<label> naming convention below and registers the move).
clean_rule: STOCKS: every result is clean (stock NPZs are causal). CRYPTO: clean only if the progress file mtime >= clean_crypto_epoch (written by a pilot launched on engine ecacb3be after the AUDIT/001 deploy 18:09:49Z and after the old pilots were killed ~18:19Z) AND the file is not in a contaminated_* folder; every other crypto result (run19 and older, run20 before the fix, anything in contaminated_*) is contaminated.

excluded_globs./home/niels/v15_run*/progress/quarantine: E3-DEFAULT-BASE bug: chain start zeroed (initial_baseline_gain 0) so every row delta is biased by the real baseline: invalid; the sym_sides were rerun in run20
